name: Refcount-zero free without invalidation (lowered-decrement variant)
description: Companion to memory-safety.refcount_free_no_invalidate for the common case where Helix/Remill lowers the atomic refcount decrement to a plain RMW on the struct field rather than keeping an atomic intrinsic call -- i.e. it appears in the C-AST as 'obj->refcount -= 1' (CBinaryExpr operator '-=' whose left operand is a '->' field access) instead of a call. Query 1 is the same free-of-a-'->'-field as the primary rule. Same over-approximation caveat: function-scoped co-occurrence only; no ordering / same-object / no-invalidation proof. A '--obj->refcount' (CUnaryExpr operator '--') form would need an additional variant since HQL signatures are AND-of-queries with no intra-signature OR.
